title: Race of the Falling Star
story: Stellagorn the Comet Hound streaks across the night sky dragging a tail of frost that freezes every lake it passes over. Mr 6 borrows the observatory's brass telescope and a sky-skiff, determined to reach Lake Bellow before the hound does and wake the sleeping fishers.
question: Stellagorn is 480 miles from Lake Bellow and flies at 60 miles per hour. Mr 6's sky-skiff is 315 miles away and flies at 45 miles per hour. How many hours BEFORE the comet hound does Mr 6 arrive?
hint: Work out each traveler's time separately with distance divided by speed, then compare the two times.
victory: Mr 6 landed a full hour early, rang the fish-bell, and every boat was ashore when Stellagorn skidded overhead. The hound, finding nothing to freeze but a puddle, licked Mr 6's helmet and became the village's very cold pet.
imagePrompt: A glowing frost-tailed hound made of comet light streaking over a moonlit lake, with a tiny caped numeral 6 knight steering a wooden sky-skiff ahead of it through starry clouds.
